claims.claim_text: A sample approval should be tied to defined specification and production route.
claims.page_or_section: Opening and Make sample point to something measurable
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Editorial purchasing interpretation; distinguishes the physical object from conditions it represents.
claims.geographic_scope: Industrial purchases; complexity adapted to product
claims.caveat: Does not claim every supplier intentionally substitutes or that any sample establishes capability.

claims.claim_text: Bosch distinguishes prototypes/pilot parts from serial deliveries and evaluates performance under series-production conditions.
claims.publication_or_revision_date: Edition 3, February 2025; sections 3.4, 4.7–4.9 and 12; customer-specific requirements.
claims.page_or_section: Edition 3 February 2025 sections 3.4 and 4.7–4.9; printed pp9,36–37
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Customer document separates part statuses and evaluates complete-process performance under production conditions.
claims.caveat: No universal run duration, sample quantity or capability limit asserted. Full AIAG/VDA standards not consulted.

claims.claim_text: Bosch approval documentation identifies tooling and production line.
claims.publication_or_revision_date: Edition 3, February 2025; sections 3.4, 4.7–4.9 and 12; customer-specific requirements.
claims.page_or_section: Printed page37, deliverable0.1; page43 tooling record
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Document requests tool and production-machine/line identifiers and tooling relationships.
claims.caveat: Article does not apply these clauses to unrelated supplier contract.

claims.claim_text: Graco change categories include relevant tooling, process, material source, packaging and inspection-method changes.
claims.publication_or_revision_date: Manufacturer examples of product, process, tooling and inspection changes.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Manufacturer lists proposed change categories and route to purchasing/quality reviewers.
claims.caveat: No invented notification period or automatic approval rule.

claims.claim_text: Infineon asks for before/after, affected sites/materials, qualification evidence and sample/date-code transition information.
claims.publication_or_revision_date: Sector-specific change information and transition planning; no universal timeline asserted.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Manufacturer describes information normally supporting its supplier-change process.
claims.caveat: No claim that all fields or automotive PPAP levels are universal.

claims.claim_text: Negotiate effective lots, existing stock disposition and separate one-time from recurring price changes.
claims.page_or_section: Negotiate transition as carefully as unit price
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Editorial commercial implementation questions based on retaining identifiable purchase basis.
claims.caveat: Does not authorize a production stop, disposition or technical concession.

claims.claim_text: Distinct from prior inspection and requote articles.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Focus is negotiation over sample-to-volume equivalence and the commercial assumptions behind the unit price.
claims.caveat: Avoids sampling tables, AQL, defect limits, shipment-release rules and repeating the old requote checklist.

limits: No invented project, quotation, numerical example or customer result. Primary source statements are attributed; proposed workflow is editorial advice.
next_review: Before publication and after relevant source or regulatory changes. Independent editorial review remains pending.
